competing_explanation: If replacing SVD DualNorm and EMPF with SVD-free per-role Quintic Newton-Schulz trust equilibration and valley-coalesced pullback regularizer degrades ordinary shallow/autoencoder/categorical/image/vector GAN stability, then t4-arch-v2 will fail a required Tier 1 gate (e.g. ring16_acquisition > 0.85 or model_ae_gan_multimodal) or collapse across Tier 2 discriminator_stability tasks.
hypothesis: One unchanged global SVD-free 1st-order clock-free recipe (t4-arch-v2) clears all 11/11 required Tier 1 gates of discriminator_stability (including ring16_acquisition <= 0.85, model_ae_gan_multimodal, model_vae_hard, five_word_joint_smoke, gaussian1d_smoke, two_pole, and zero_tanh_smoke) and executes Tier 2 discriminator_stability tasks (passing grid100, rotated100, staggered100, precision_gaussian_*, vector_*, and img_*) under protocol seed 0.
